title: Purani Asam Buranji: From King Sukapha Across the Patkai to King Gadadhar Singha
title_english: Purani Asam Buranji: From King Sukapha Across the Patkai to King Gadadhar Singha
title_as: পুৰণি অসম-বুৰঞ্জী: চুকাফাৰ পৰা গদাধৰ সিংহলৈ
author: Pandit Hemchandra Goswami (Ed.)
provenance: Kamarupa Anusandhan Samiti (Assam Research Society), Gauhati; DLI Archive 2015.452171
description: The foundational ancient chronicle of Assam edited from primary sanchi-bark manuscripts by Pandit Hemchandra Goswami, recording Chao Lung Sukapha's departure from Mong Mao in 1215 A.D., his passage through Nora territory, the Patkai crossing, and the founding of the kingdom at Charaideo.
